info.title: Audorix.ChatX API
info.description: REST API of Audorix.ChatX. Application endpoints live under /api/v1/.

get.summary: Describes the public API surface of this installation.
get.description: Unauthenticated. Contains no build, runtime, host or database details.

get.summary: Whether the installation still needs the setup wizard.
Installation metadata. Requires the installation.read permission.

post.summary: Populates demo data: 300 people (password Demo123!), 50 companies, contacts, 150 groups, 800 channels, direct conversations, messages and activity (mentions, saved messages, reminders, scheduled messages: 500 items for the caller, 50-100 for everyone else). Idempotent; only where DemoData:Enabled. The caller is included.

get.summary: How much demo data exists.

delete.summary: Removes only the demo data: demo people (and what they wrote), demo companies and demo conversations. Conversations and data real people created stay.

get.summary: Messages that mention the caller (by name, @everyone or @here), newest first, with their unread state.
The caller's saved messages they can still read, most recently saved first.
How many mentions of the caller are in unread messages.

post.summary: Uploads a file (multipart/form-data, field 'file') into a conversation. Send it with a message using its id. Unsent uploads are removed after 24 hours.

get.summary: Searches the messages the caller can read (from their join), newest first (order=oldest for oldest first). Every word of q matches as a prefix, case- and accent-insensitive; message text and attachment file names. Optional filters: conversationId, senderId, from/to (UTC), hasFiles. The first page also has counts (all matches, and those with files).
Your drafts, most recently changed first.
Public sign-in configuration (captcha site key, enabled providers).
Issues the antiforgery token required on state-changing requests.

post.summary: Ends the current session.
Creates a local account and sends a confirmation email.
Confirms an email address from an emailed link.
Sends a new confirmation link if the account is unconfirmed.
Signs in with email and password; sets the session cookie.
Emails a password reset link if the account exists.
Sets a new password from an emailed link; signs out all sessions.

get.summary: Starts sign-in with an enabled external provider (google, microsoft).
Lists the caller's active sessions.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the caller's sessions.

post.summary: Revokes every session except the current one.

get.summary: The signed-in user's account, profile and preferences.

put.summary: Updates the display name.
Updates user preferences (language, theme, desktop notifications); omitted fields stay unchanged.

post.summary: Changes the password and signs out other sessions.

get.summary: Whether the account can be deleted now, and what stands in the way (organizations you are the only owner of).

post.summary: Deletes the signed-in account after confirming the password (or, without one, the email address). Personal data is erased; messages stay as "Deleted user". Signs out everywhere.

get.summary: Finds users by exact email address, or by name among people sharing an organization. Never returns emails.
A user's public summary, if the caller has a relationship with them.

delete.summary: Removes a contact (either side may remove).

get.summary: Pending incoming and outgoing contact requests.

post.summary: Sends a contact request. If the other user already asked, the two become contacts.

delete.summary: Cancels the caller's own outgoing request.

post.summary: Blocks a user: removes the contact, closes pending requests and prevents new ones both ways.

get.summary: Organizations the caller is an active member of.

post.summary: Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner. A default workspace is created.

put.summary: Renames the organization (owners and administrators).

post.summary: Deletes the organization and everything in it (owners only; confirmName repeats its name). Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Active members; pending invitations for owners and administrators.

put.summary: Changes a member's role (owners only). The last owner cannot be demoted.

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves when the user is the caller. The last owner cannot leave. Ends the person's organization conversations.

put.summary: Grants or removes the Support Agent role (owners and administrators).
Organization-specific configuration: guests on/off and who creates channels (owners and administrators).

post.summary: Invites an email address (owners and administrators). Does not reveal whether the address has an account.

get.summary: Open invitations addressed to the caller's confirmed email address.
Workspaces the caller can access (all of them for organization administrators).

post.summary: Creates a workspace (organization owners and administrators).
Adds an active organization member to the workspace.

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves. Also ends the person's channels in the workspace and their team memberships.

put.summary: Changes a workspace member's role (workspace or organization administrators).
Renames a workspace (workspace or organization administrators).

get.summary: The caller's conversations, most recent activity first, with unread counts.
The caller's conversations a page at a time (default 50, at most 200), in list order. Pass nextCursor as 'after' for the next page.

post.summary: Opens the direct conversation with a contact (or, with organizationId, an organization member). Returns the existing one if it exists.
Creates a group. Personal groups may include the caller's contacts; organization groups its active members.

put.summary: Renames a group or changes its description (owners and administrators).

get.summary: History visible to the caller (from their join), newest page first; items ascending. Pass nextCursor as 'before' for older entries.
A message with up to 'size' (default 3, at most 20) main-timeline entries before and after it, ascending; never before the caller's join.

post.summary: Moves the caller's read position forward (it never moves back).
Delivery acknowledgement (ADR-023): a device of the caller received everything up to the sequence.

put.summary: The caller's own settings for the conversation: notification level all, mentions or nothing (muted: true is mentions).

get.summary: Files shared in the conversation that the caller may see (not deleted, from their join), newest first; default 30, at most 100. Pass nextCursor as 'before' for older files.

put.summary: Pins or unpins the conversation at the top of the caller's own list (personal; nobody else sees it).

get.summary: The conversation's pinned messages, most recently pinned first.

post.summary: Adds people to a group (owners and administrators). Their history starts now.

delete.summary: Removes someone from a group (administrators remove members, owners anyone). Removing yourself leaves.

put.summary: Changes a participant's role (owners). The last owner cannot be demoted.

post.summary: Leaves a group; access ends immediately. If the last owner leaves, the longest-standing member becomes owner.
Sends a plain-text message (optionally a reply, optionally with uploaded attachments). Idempotent by clientMessageId: a retry returns the original with 200.

put.summary: Edits the caller's own message within the edit window (15 minutes by default).

delete.summary: Deletes a message (own messages; group owners and administrators also others'). A tombstone stays in history.

put.summary: Adds (reacted: true) or removes the caller's emoji reaction; returns the message's reactions. Not in website chats; at most 20 distinct emoji per message.

get.summary: A thread: its first message and the newest page of replies (ascending). Pass nextCursor as 'before' for older replies.

post.summary: Moves the caller's read position in the thread forward; returns the replies still unread.

put.summary: Follows or stops following a thread. Followers are notified about its replies.
Pins or unpins a message: either person in direct conversations, owners and administrators in groups and channels; at most 50 per conversation.
Saves (bookmarks) or unsaves a message for the caller.

post.summary: Forwards a copy of the message (text and files, credited to its author) to another conversation of the caller, optionally after a comment.

get.summary: Size, count and type limits for uploads.
Attachment metadata: your own uploads in any state, others' once ready and visible to you.

delete.summary: Removes your own unsent upload. Sent files are removed by deleting their message.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment. Authorized on every request through its conversation; images are shown inline unless download=true.
Running private chats: those you started in this session, and invitations or chats you were invited to.

post.summary: Invites a contact or organization colleague to a private chat bound to this sign-in session. They must accept first.

get.summary: The chat and everything said so far (from memory).

delete.summary: Ends the chat (initiator) or declines the invitation (invitee). Messages and files are wiped at once.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation (invitee).
Sends a message into an active private chat. Idempotent by clientMessageId while the chat lasts.
Keeps a file in memory for this private chat (multipart/form-data, field 'file'). Wiped when the chat ends.

get.summary: Downloads a file of the chat. Never cached.
Installation overview: counts, providers in use and pending restarts.
Live settings: features, access, limits, languages and audit retention, with their source.

put.summary: Changes live settings; they apply to the next request. A null value resets a setting. Keys set by the environment are locked.

get.summary: Email, captcha, storage and scanning settings. Secret values are never returned.

put.summary: Validates and saves provider settings to the settings file; they apply after a restart. Omitted secrets stay unchanged.

post.summary: Tries provider settings without saving them: email sends to you, storage writes/reads/deletes a probe, scanning scans a sample.

get.summary: Installation roles and their permissions.
Audit log, newest first. Filters: action (or prefix ending with '.'), actor, target, outcome.
Searches accounts by email or name; filter: all, enabled, disabled, unconfirmed (or a role name); role: a role name or none; sort: nameAsc, nameDesc.

delete.summary: Deletes an account: personal data is erased, messages stay as "Deleted user". Refused for yourself, the last administrator and sole organization owners (409 sole_owner).

post.summary: Disables an account and signs it out everywhere. Not possible for yourself or the last administrator.
Signs the account out on every device.
Grants an installation role.

delete.summary: Revokes an installation role (never the last administrator's).

get.summary: Searches organizations by name; sort: nameAsc, nameDesc, members (most first).

post.summary: Deletes an organization and everything in it (confirmName repeats its name). Cannot be undone.

put.summary: Changes a member's organization role. The last owner cannot be demoted.

delete.summary: Removes a member (and their organization conversations). The last owner cannot be removed.

get.summary: Public channels of the workspace, the caller's private ones, and every channel for administrators.

post.summary: Creates a channel; the creator becomes its manager. Optional people and teams (linked: later team members join too).

put.summary: Renames, describes or changes the visibility of a channel (managers).
Archives a channel (read-only: history stays, nobody can post, react, join or be added) or restores it (managers).

post.summary: Joins a public channel (workspace members). History starts now.
Adds workspace members and teams (managers). People already in the channel are skipped.

delete.summary: Removes someone (managers), or leaves.

put.summary: Makes someone a channel manager or a plain member (managers). Guests cannot manage.

delete.summary: Unlinks a team; people it added stay in the channel.

post.summary: Creates a team (workspace or organization administrators).

delete.summary: Deletes a team (administrators). Channel members it added stay.

post.summary: Adds a workspace member (team managers and administrators); they join the team's linked channels.

delete.summary: Removes someone from the team (managers), or leaves. Their channels stay.

get.summary: Active guests and their channels (owners and administrators).

delete.summary: Ends a guest's access and removes them from all channels of the organization.

post.summary: Invites an email address into one channel as a guest (owners and administrators). Does not reveal whether the address has an account.

get.summary: Open guest invitations addressed to the caller's confirmed email address.
Website conversations: all of them for support agents and administrators, the caller's own for responders. Filter by status (open/closed) and mine=true.

post.summary: Takes the conversation: assigns it to the caller, who joins it with the whole history.

put.summary: Assigns to a support agent, administrator or taking-part responder, or unassigns with null (support agents and administrators).
Closes or reopens the conversation. A visitor's new message reopens it.

get.summary: The organization's website widgets (owners and administrators).

post.summary: Creates a widget (switched off). The signing secret is returned once; keep it on your server.

put.summary: Changes a widget. Null fields stay unchanged. Switching it on needs an allowed origin and a responder.

post.summary: Replaces the signing secret. Identity tokens signed with the old secret stop working at once.

get.summary: Search provider in use and the number of message changes waiting to be indexed.

post.summary: Empties the search index and indexes every message again (after switching providers, or to repair the index).

get.summary: Whether Web Push is available, and the VAPID public key browsers subscribe with.

post.summary: Registers this browser for push notifications (the body is PushSubscription.toJSON()). Subscribing again replaces it.
Stops push notifications to this browser.

put.summary: Saves your draft for the conversation (or a thread). Empty text without a reply target removes it.

post.summary: Schedules a message (up to 30 days ahead, 50 waiting per person). It is sent with the normal rules at its time.
Reminds you about a message at a time (in the app, by push, and by email when you are away).

get.summary: Your scheduled messages: waiting ones by time, then those that could not be sent.

put.summary: Changes the text or time of a waiting scheduled message.

delete.summary: Cancels a waiting scheduled message, or removes one that could not be sent.

get.summary: Your reminders on messages you can still read: due ones first, then by time.

delete.summary: Marks a reminder done, or cancels one that is not due yet.

get.summary: The current change cursor. Take one after loading what you show; use it after reconnecting.
What changed since a cursor (at most 500 changes, kept 24 hours): the current state of each changed entry you can see, or reset: true to reload.
Public appearance of an enabled widget. Contains no secrets.
Origins allowed to frame the widget; the web server turns them into frame-ancestors. Unknown or disabled widgets allow none.

post.summary: Starts a visitor session: anonymous (if the widget allows it) or with an identity token your server signed (HS256 with the widget secret).

delete.summary: Ends the visitor session (the conversation stays for the organization).

get.summary: The visitor's conversation (empty until the first message), newest page first; items ascending.

post.summary: Sends a message; the first one starts the conversation with the widget's responders. Idempotent by clientMessageId.
Moves the visitor's read position forward.
Delivery acknowledgement for the visitor's device.
Uploads a file (multipart/form-data, field 'file'). Identified visitors only.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment of the visitor's conversation.
